This maize plot is small, only 0.10 hectares, but it feeds my family so I must take care of it. I am hoping to get a FISP coupon this year because without the subsidy I cannot afford fertilizer at market price — if I get the coupon I will use NPK at planting and urea for top-dressing. I will also put some manure from the goats because the soil here in Dedza is tired, and I will try to buy a small packet of hybrid seed since the yields are better than the local seed I saved. I cannot irrigate and I will not buy pesticide; my husband and I will do the weeding ourselves, maybe asking a neighbor for one or two days of ganyu if the weeds get ahead of us.
